statusStatement: As of October 15, 2026: SBIR and STTR are authorized through September 30, 2031 (S. 3971, signed April 13, 2026). Always check sbir.gov for the latest.
notes: Build-time static data only. Nothing on the pages is fetched at runtime.

A source with retrieved: null was cited from search results or a secondary page and was not fetched by this build.

sources.title: SBIR.gov award data download (no-abstract CSV), all agencies, 1983 to 2026
sources.usedFor: Every chart on the hub and the agencies pages, the phase-gap chart and the median Phase I chart.
sources.transformation: Downloaded the public award CSV (219,649 rows, generic user agent). src/data/sbir/tools/aggregate.py drops contact columns, drops rows without a year or an amount, groups by fiscal year (October to September) and by calendar month of the award date, pools agencies over fiscal years 2020 to 2024, states over 2015 to 2024, and matches companies by normalised name for first-time, repeat-winner and Phase I to Phase II measures. The raw file is never committed; only src/data/sbir/aggregates.ts is.
sources.caveat: Name matching undercounts name changes and overcounts first-time awardees. The most recent months can be undercounted while agencies report. The API (api.www.sbir.gov) returned 403, so the bulk file was used.

sources.caveat: NIH only. No other agency publishes a comparable standard table that this build found, so the pages do not compare agencies by success rate. Fiscal year 2025 Phase II is not in the table.
